clips.title: The story
paras: Deep within Gnomeregan, the Dark Iron Ambassador draws notice as an envoy of his clan. His presence leaves the clan’s interest in the ruined gnome capital unexplained.
Among Gnomeregan’s irradiated halls, the Dark Iron Ambassador represents his clan. No one explains the purpose of his mission.
